queries_run: Incyte third quarter 2026 results Jakafi Opzelura Niktimvo revenue growth
Incyte Jakafi 2026 guidance loss of exclusivity 2028 Opzelura market share pricing

findings.claim: Q3 2026：總營收年增14%；Jakafi淨銷售+4%至$827M（付費需求+12%）；Opzelura +36%至$255M（含與CMS和解後淨價改善，pro forma約+21%）；血液腫瘤合計+38%至$235M；Niktimvo $67.4M vs $45.8M
Q2 2026上調全年指引：總淨銷售$5,130–5,260M、Opzelura $1,050–1,100M（原$750–790M）、Jakafi維持$3,220–3,270M；Opzelura上調與CMS不將其視為Jakafi line extension的和解（返利）有關
Jakafi美國專利到期（LOE）約2028年12月，之後預期學名藥ruxolitinib侵蝕；公司目標2030年非Jakafi產品淨銷售$3–4B；ER劑型轉換目標3–5%
findings.source: Fierce Pharma 'As Jakafi approaches generic competition, Incyte counts more on Opzelura'

findings.claim: Opzelura在美國品牌外用藥新患者份額46%；美國以外Q2銷售$43M，年增34%
findings.source: Fierce Pharma 'Boosted by CMS settlement, Incyte expects Opzelura to cross $1B in 2026'

end_markets.note: 僅執行2次搜尋；摘要為搜尋工具轉述非逐字原文，故excerpt為null。未查end market TAM共識。
